versions.content: Maximal number of unicast servers that may connect to the local unicast client address If the DdsCpConsumedServiceInstance references an ApplicationEndpoint in the role localUnicastAddress then the attribute ApplicationEndpoint . maxNumberOfConnections defines the maximal number of remote endpoints that will be able to connect to this local server address. The SoAd will setup a SocketConnection for each potential client with localUnicastAddress . The local Address of the SocketConnection is derived from localUnicastAddress .
